title: Branching wheels
summary: Adjacent child wheels keep each submenu connected to its parent. The default layout on new installations and upgrades.
constraints: Geometry adapts to the screen; foreign drag keyboard grabs remain best effort.

title: Optional Concentric Rings
summary: Explore submenus as outward rings around a fixed session center. Choose the layout in Control Center → Wheel.
constraints: Requires compositing and sufficient space. The application defaults reserve 668 × 742 logical pixels; custom geometry changes the requirement. A session can fall back to Branching without rewriting settings.

title: Drag + Shift
summary: Start dragging files in Nemo, then press Shift to bring actions to the cursor. A second press hides the wheel and resumes native dragging.
constraints: X11 only. With input.passthrough=false, release outside the active wheel to cancel. The modifier is configurable.

title: Invoke mode
summary: Use Nemo’s Open in Radivine action or radivine invoke with file paths. Navigate by pointer or keyboard.
constraints: The wheel requires an X11 connection. Desktop shortcuts are configured manually. XWayland Invoke is experimental, not native Wayland support.

title: Context-aware actions
summary: Menus reflect the selection. Inspection can show Checking… or a disabled action with a reason.
constraints: Inspection is bounded; multiple selections do not imply every file has been examined before display. Properties needs a compatible file-manager D-Bus service. Copy places file URIs on the X11 clipboard, not bytes in a destination folder.

title: Read-only text preview
summary: Full, Head and Tail open a separate viewer with virtualized reads and search.
constraints: One eligible local text file at a time. No editing, graphical image preview or live-follow tail -f.

title: Quick image conversion
summary: Choose Convert → Image → PNG, JPEG or WebP to queue a conversion, including supported batch selections.
constraints: Static raster images only. Mixed batches report skipped inputs; same-target Quick Convert may be disabled or skipped. No animated GIF/APNG/WebP, AVIF, HEIC, SVG, PDF or audio/video conversion.

title: Advanced Convert
summary: Use a native dialog for presets, quality, resize, orientation, metadata and output-location choices. Same-format re-encoding is available.
constraints: Defaults limit source size to 512 MiB, allocation to 256 MiB, each dimension to 16,384 px and total pixels to 100 MP; effective settings may differ. EXIF is stripped by default; metadata behavior depends on target format.

title: Background jobs
summary: A separate on-demand worker keeps durable job history. Follow progress, cancel, or create linked retries in Control Center → Jobs.
constraints: Crash recovery reconciles jobs; it does not promise automatic continuation of unfinished work. Output uses separate, no-overwrite commits. Filesystem and custom-command effects still need care.

title: Custom executable actions
summary: Connect installed programs using validated TOML argv templates, selection filters, timeouts and notification policies.
constraints: Programs must exist at absolute paths. No shell expansion or partial placeholders. Default terminal, checksum and executable menu examples only log; they do not run those commands.

title: Native Control Center
summary: Manage the daemon, wheel, custom actions, conversion settings, Jobs, Diagnostics and About from a separate native window.
constraints: Login startup is opt-in. Closing Control Center leaves the daemon running. System tray integration is deferred.

title: Themes and configuration
summary: Choose Dark, Light or Auto for the application, adjust scaling and reduced motion, and keep settings in TOML or use Control Center.
constraints: The website’s Light/Dark/System preference is independent of the application. Auto detection follows desktop settings; system fonts affect non-Latin text and widget containers remain LTR.
